geographic_scope: Continental-slope PGW outflow offshore the northern coast of Oman; source study combines two across-shelf transects. No unique core station, endpoint contour, full-current footprint or geographical bottom is reconstructed.
temporal_scope: Published study synthesis of repeated glider transects during 2015-2016 and 2021-2022; separate locations, platforms and discontinuous deployments. These two reported depth descriptors are not assigned to an exact occupation, month, season or common annual mean.
source_citation: Font, Swart, Bruss, Sheehan, Heywood and Queste (2024), Ventilation of the Arabian Sea Oxygen Minimum Zone by Persian Gulf Water, JGR Oceans 129, e2023JC020668.
source_locator: Section 4.1 opening paragraph, printed page 5 of 16; Figures 2 and 3 are cited by the authors, not digitized here.
qualification: Regional source-reported property-defined PGW depth evidence. Core is not a velocity maximum; regional band is not one paired profile or a thickness. Source gridding/interpolation and distinct observing sections retained. No exact core station, shared annual mean, annual extrema, physical bottom, uncertainty or stored volume.
source_definition: Property-defined PGW concentration/core within the hydrographic outflow. Source Section 4.1 explicitly distinguishes maximum PGW fraction from maximum velocity; not a maximum-speed core depth.
